title: Remote wallet storage synchronization and HTTP interoperability

vectors.title: Mediated initial synchronization
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Load canonical synthetic user and transaction records into reference storage A.
Use the ITCVE multi-remote wallet to synchronize through the public boundary into empty SUT storage B.
Query B through an independent reader and canonical projection.
expected: User identities, transaction bytes/status, outputs, spending links, baskets, tags, labels, certificates and proof references match the fixture scope.
Local database surrogate IDs may differ only under an explicit identity mapping; relationships cannot be discarded.

vectors.title: Incremental updates and idempotence
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Apply canonical record updates and sync checkpoints through the multi-remote wallet.
Replay a completed chunk and inspect final state.
expected: No acknowledged record is lost or duplicated.
Repeated sync converges to the exact semantic record set, including declared deletion/tombstone behavior.

vectors.title: Restart, resume and provider failover
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Pause at a declared chunk boundary and restart B.
Resume through the wallet, then switch the active provider to B.
Perform a new action and read it through a freshly initialized client.
expected: Checkpoint progress remains consistent with committed records.
Wallet state remains usable and portable after provider substitution.

vectors.title: Transaction and proof state fidelity
vectors.applicability: Required within the selected draft profile; exceptions require a prospective versioned rule.
preconditions: Digest-locked admitted SUT and dependency closure
steps: Synchronize pending, accepted, mined, rejected, abandoned and conflicted fixture states where supported by the frozen contract.
Observe proof updates and resulting output availability.
expected: Transaction and proof identities remain consistent across servers.
Nonspendable outputs never become spendable merely because they were synchronized.

expected: Public storage calls honor the declared identity binding and method contract.
Each identity observes precisely its expected record set.
